newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Clal Electronics Q2 net soars.
newsitem.headline: Clal Electronics Q2 net soars.

text.p: Clal Electronics Industries Ltd reported the following results to the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange on Tuesday.

Clal Electronics, a high technology holding company, said in a statement that the increase in net profit was due to capital gains from the sale of shares in its ECI Telecom affiliate and to an agreement with income tax authorities.
In May, Clal sold 1.65 million ECI shares, which realised a gain of 87.1 million shekels. Clal's stake in ECI fell to 23.9 percent as a result.
ECI also contributed to Clal's earnings as it boosted attributable net profit to 56.6 million shekels in the first half versus 47.2 million shekels a year earlier.
Scitex Corp, however, saw its loss attributable to Clal widen in the half to 4.0 million shekels from 1.5 million shekels a year earlier.
Clal said group revenues edged down to 2.44 billion shekels in half from 2.54 billion shekels the same time in 1996.
